request: how did my spending pile up in the first half vs the second half?

plan.title: Spending added up, half against half
plan.question: Spending of 2025 added up inside each half of the year, one row per half and per month of that half, the running total per half, columns month_of_half as '1' to '6', half as 'First half' or 'Second half' and cumulative_eur.

sql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', booked_on) AS INTEGER) AS mn, -SUM(amount) AS spent
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0
  GROUP BY mn
)
SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN mn <= 6 THEN mn ELSE mn - 6 END AS TEXT) AS month_of_half,
       CASE WHEN mn <= 6 THEN 'First half' ELSE 'Second half' END AS half,
       ROUND(SUM(spent) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN mn <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ORDER BY mn), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM m
ORDER BY half, mn
reasoning_plan:
the request is written in English, so language en
"pile up" is a running total, and two halves are compared
an area with one band per half reads the gap between them
the columns are month_of_half, half and cumulative_eur
the position is the month inside the half, so both bands start together
reasoning_code:
the shape is area, so areaY draws the band and lineY its edge
the columns are month_of_half, half, cumulative_eur, and cumulative_eur holds the numbers
half names the series, so it is the z and the color channel on both marks and the legend goes on
the bands are compared and not added, so each rests on zero itself: y1 zero, y2 the figure
labels on x, none of them dropped, euros on y

request: each month, did i spend more or less than the month before?

plan.title: Change to the month before
plan.question: For each month of 2025 the difference between its spending and the spending of the month before, signed so a cheaper month is negative, one row per month, columns month as 'YYYY-MM' and change_eur.

sql:
WITH per AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, -SUM(amount) AS spent
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, change_eur FROM (
  SELECT month, ROUND(spent - LAG(spent) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS change_eur FROM per
) AS d
WHERE change_eur IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month
